description:
Hushfeed v0.32.0 targets global TikTok 46.2.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

Every control Hushfeed draws over the video answers a press and shows where the focus is, and so do the settings screen's hand-built actions, so a keyboard, a d-pad or switch access can see where it is. A chosen gate in the Feature Gate Lab looks chosen. The daily hold no longer reads itself out once a second to TalkBack, and the daily budget label stays on the feed. One sentence asks for a restart instead of nine, the Region summaries name their switches by the titles those switches carry in all four languages, the budget rows and the tab picker are translated, the hidden creators editor keeps what you typed, the country lists check what you type, copied sound links are cleaned, the Not interested button no longer goes dead, double tap set to open comments opens them, and the exported diagnostic report no longer names the creators you block, hide or follow.

Validation: 1267 runtime tests passed locally, plus 178 in the patches module. The bundle carries 79 patches and all three DEX payloads are non-empty. Both Android API checks passed. All patches applied with zero failures to the 46.2.3, 46.7.3 and 46.8.3 fixtures. Needs Morphe Manager 1.29.0 or newer.

The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.
